turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on always, usually, sometimes and never?
turns.tutor:
Always, usually, sometimes, never: here is the rule.
These words go before the action word, but after am, is or are.
Right: "Owls usually hunt at night."
Not right: "Owls hunt usually at night." Usually comes too late there.
Watch me: "The zoo is always busy." I see is. So always goes after is.
Help my cousin get to school! Put the words in order:
Put the words in order: "usually / my cousin / walks / to school"
